configurations.name: control-plane
runtimeArgs: set -a; . ./.env; set +a; HTTP_ADDR=:8091 GRPC_ADDR=:9491 PUBLIC_HTTP_URL=http://localhost:8091 exec ./control-plane/bin/control-plane

runtimeArgs: set -a; . ./.env; set +a; API_BASE=http://127.0.0.1:8091/api/v1 PORT=3001; cd web && exec npx next dev -p 3001
